name: @gami/identity
note: Adapters here are the ONLY place in this repo allowed to import @privy-io/* or wagmi (eslint rule 1, §11.3). devDependencies duplicate the peerDeps purely so `tsc --noEmit` has something to resolve types against in this workspace; apps/mobile and apps/web supply the real runtime versions. Two subpath exports, not one barrel — apps/mobile imports only "@gami/identity/mobile", apps/web only "@gami/identity/web". A single shared entry point re-exporting both platforms made Metro try to resolve @privy-io/react-auth (web-only, pulls in styled-components) for apps/mobile just because it imported anything from this package at all — found by actually running a real bundle, not by inspection.
